metadata.title: test: add secrets detection hook regressions
metadata.author: lucarlig

description:
## 🔗 Related Issue
Related internal mirror issue: [contextforge-org/mcp-context-forge#5](https://github.ibm.com/contextforge-org/mcp-context-forge/issues/5)

---

## 📝 Summary
This PR adds regression coverage for the secrets detection plugin hook paths reported in the issue: `prompt_pre_fetch`, `tool_post_invoke`, and `resource_post_fetch`.

Only test changes were needed because targeted local verification showed the current plugin implementation already handled the reported redact-only and block-only behaviors correctly. The gap was missing automated coverage for those scenarios through the framework dispatch path, so this PR codifies those cases to prevent regressions.

reviews.author: gandhipratik203
reviews.body: **Nit (non-blocking):** The three blocking tests (`test_prompt_pre_fetch_blocks_without_redaction`, `test_tool_post_invoke_blocks_without_redaction`, `test_resource_post_fetch_blocks_without_redaction`) assert `result.modified_payload == payload`. This works via Pydantic value equality, but the `modified_payload` here is backfilled by the **executor** (`manager.py:361-363`), not set by the plugin itself. A brief inline comment would help future readers understand this isn't testing plugin output directly.

reviews.author: crivetimihai
reviews.body:
Looks good — well-structured regression tests for the three secrets detection hook dispatch paths (prompt_pre_fetch, tool_post_invoke, resource_post_fetch).

**What was reviewed:**
- All 6 new tests correctly exercise the real `PluginManager.invoke_hook` dispatch, not just direct plugin method calls
- Redact paths verify `continue_processing=True`, modified payload contents, and metadata
- Block paths verify `continue_processing=False`, violation code, and payload backfill behavior
- Test isolation is solid: `PluginManager.reset()` autouse fixture + `try/finally` shutdown
- Consistent with existing test patterns in the codebase

**Changes made during rebase:**
- Rebased onto main, removed merge commit
- Regenerated `.secrets.baseline` (line number shift 466 → 665)
- Fixed isort import section ordering
